scope: all BdE-Circular / BOE-source semantics reachable from the proven pipeline (watcher -> sources -> operations -> ownership -> binding -> history -> applicability -> query/diffing)

classifications.PROFILE_MATERIAL: vocabulary/grammar/identity that belongs to the source profile
classifications.CORE: source-independent policy or taxonomy; must justify independence
classifications.PROFILE_INPUT_CORE_POLICY: diagnostic seam — profile vocabulary feeding a core policy; PORT-1 must split it into an explicit interface

items.item: BOE URL scheme: BOE_BASE, XML_URL, DOC_URL, PDF_URL
items.semantic_responsibility: derive artifact URLs for a target's diario XML, doc HTML, annex PDFs, images
items.bde_specific_evidence: literal www.boe.es paths
items.why: pure source addressing; no proof content
items.fixture_coverage: all reconstruction runs via frozen manifests (URL recorded in snapshot rows)

items.semantic_responsibility: derive the target's canonical reference (n, year) used by ownership attribution
items.bde_specific_evidence: 'Circular N/AAAA' is the BdE Circular naming convention
items.why: target-reference derivation is per-source identity grammar
items.fixture_coverage: every DEV/HIST target resolves through it (16+1 instruments)

items.semantic_responsibility: build the declared-modifier edge list for a target
items.bde_specific_evidence: 'posteriores' is a boe_diario metadata field; 'CORREG...' is BOE palabra vocabulary
items.why: the policy 'the amendment graph comes from declared source metadata' is core; the metadata field name and kind vocabulary are profile
items.fixture_coverage: all declared modifiers in frozen manifests

items.semantic_responsibility: frozen-oracle coverage check: a bound span must restate the subject's distinguishing token
items.bde_specific_evidence: locator-kind word list and Spanish ordinal alternates
items.why: the coverage policy (restatement requirement, whole-subject exemption) is core evidence semantics; the kind list and ordinal words are profile vocabulary
items.fixture_coverage: B1-B6 audit paths; COV-2 evaluator replay

items.semantic_responsibility: normalize and tokenize data-file names for equality
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish stopword connector list; 'fichero' is a BdE document structure
items.why: name-equality vocabulary; policy trivially follows profile
items.fixture_coverage: fichero subjects in DEV corpus; tests/g0g

items.semantic_responsibility: detect operative qualifiers that scope below the locator model
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish sub-scope vocabulary (módulo/dimensión/cuadro/fila/columna...)
items.why: pure vocabulary; the gating policy consuming it is core (F1 semantics)

items.item: _target_annex_map: boe_doc HTML -> annex PDF -> text layer -> AnnexMap
items.semantic_responsibility: assemble annex page-mapping evidence for image/PDF representations
items.bde_specific_evidence: boe_doc/boe_pdf parsers and 'boe_imagen' source id
items.why: orchestration policy (which artifact chain proves a page) is core; the parsers and source ids are profile

items.semantic_responsibility: emit artifact_locator values recorded in representation rows
items.bde_specific_evidence: source ids and node-span addressing are BOE-XML specific; the locator types are emitted vocabulary
items.why: the artifact_locator schema is core contract (must stay byte-identical); how a source locates a span inside its own artifacts is profile
items.fixture_coverage: every representation row in every frozen run

items.item: instrument_id / subject_id / modification_relation_id hashing over boe_id token
items.semantic_responsibility: deterministic identity derivation for instruments, subjects, relations
items.bde_specific_evidence: the 'boe_id' string form is the source's identifier scheme
items.why: hash-of-identity-parts is core policy; the canonical instrument token itself is the profile's identifier scheme
items.fixture_coverage: every id in every ledger (renaming would break byte-identity — ids are emitted values)

items.semantic_responsibility: detect operative amendment verbs and map them to op kinds (SUBSTITUTE/DELETE/ADD/MODIFY)
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish BOE drafting verb inventory, incl. exclusions ('desglosa', 'incluir' restricted to structural objects)
items.why: verb vocabulary and structural-object whitelist are profile; the op-kind taxonomy, operative-position rule (subordinator check) and earliest/nearest-verb derivations are core policy
items.fixture_coverage: every operation row; G1 audit contract; test_cov2_subscope

items.semantic_responsibility: decide whether an active 'se <verb>' is in main or subordinate position
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish subordinator word list
items.why: word list is profile; 'subordinate occurrences are referential, not operative' is a core adjudication policy

items.semantic_responsibility: recognize clause openings that introduce subjects
items.bde_specific_evidence: 'En la norma...', bare 'Estado PI 2:', marker strip forms
items.why: clause-surface vocabulary; the walker policy consuming it is core

items.semantic_responsibility: locate operation-owned content (quoted spans, pointer phrases, annex references, literal pairs)
items.bde_specific_evidence: BOE drafting phrases ('donde dice', 'que figura en el anejo de esta circular', «» quoting)
items.why: phrase inventory is profile; the content-ownership policy and CONTENT_LINK_METHODS taxonomy are core

items.semantic_responsibility: extract 'Circular N/AAAA' refs; owner construction wins; single unambiguous ref attributes
items.bde_specific_evidence: 'Circular del Banco de España N/AAAA' forms
items.why: the ref syntax is profile; 'owner construction wins over every mention' is core attribution policy

items.semantic_responsibility: Spanish ordinal word <-> number mapping, incl. feminine forms and 'única'
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish-language vocabulary (shared across ES sources, still profile-side)
items.why: pure vocabulary; three duplicated copies should consolidate into the profile

items.semantic_responsibility: recognize estado/fichero code identifiers wherever they appear
items.bde_specific_evidence: the FI/FC/PI/PC/PA/UEM/AVE families are BdE Circular reporting-state codes — the single most BdE-specific vocabulary in the codebase
items.why: the code families are pure profile vocabulary; the anchor-vs-subject policy ('a continuación del estado X' is positional, not a subject) is core adjudication. Four scattered copies of the same family list is exactly the coupling the profile exists to remove
items.fixture_coverage: estado:* subjects across DEV; ANNEX_CODE_NOT_LOCATED census class

items.semantic_responsibility: recognize data-file subjects
items.bde_specific_evidence: BdE data-file naming convention
items.why: vocabulary

items.semantic_responsibility: close the subject zone at a non-operative qualifier
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish clause-closing phrases
items.why: phrase is profile; 'the tail closes subject scope' is core policy

items.semantic_responsibility: turn clause text into locator_key values incl. enumerations and hierarchical dotted ids
items.bde_specific_evidence: BdE/Spanish structural vocabulary and enumeration separators (a/al/y/e/,)
items.why: kind words, lookahead sets and separators are profile; the tokenizing policy ('a hierarchical dotted identifier is one value, never a range'; every enumerated value declares a subject) is core semantics
items.fixture_coverage: all locator_key values in ledgers; G2.1 §25 anchors

items.semantic_responsibility: split a clause into segments for per-subject verb attribution
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish punctuation/conjunction split set
items.why: vocabulary; the scoping policy is core

items.item: _norm — NFKD accent-strip + lowercase + whitespace collapse (operations._norm; reused by history/binding)
items.semantic_responsibility: canonicalize Spanish text for comparison
items.bde_specific_evidence: language-level, not BdE-level; but lives inside the BdE module
items.why: ES-language utility; belongs to profile vocabulary layer (or a shared es-legal-text util the profile owns)

items.semantic_responsibility: expand a locator_key into textual mention alternatives (kind-word + ordinal-word + roman forms)
items.bde_specific_evidence: kind-word inventory and ordinal alternates
items.why: vocabulary profile; expansion policy core

items.semantic_responsibility: assign each subject the verb nearest its deepest mention
items.bde_specific_evidence: consumes profile vocabulary but the derivation is source-independent
items.why: the nearest-mention adjudication rule is an evidence policy the frozen evaluator re-applies; only its vocabulary inputs are profile

items.semantic_responsibility: track and displace root-family context across clause scope frames
items.bde_specific_evidence: the root-family set is BdE Circular structure vocabulary
items.why: family names are profile; the displacement policy ('a declared root kills inherited roots of other families plus composed subjects') is core semantics proven by G2.1 §21-23

items.semantic_responsibility: detect when the real subject is below/beside the recorded locator
items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish qualifier vocabulary (bis, ter, quáter, quinquies...)
items.why: vocabulary profile; 'unmodelled qualifier => coarser recorded locator' is core scope policy

items.semantic_responsibility: which boe_diario node classes may carry locator content
items.bde_specific_evidence: class names are boe_diario.xml node classes
items.why: source document-model vocabulary
items.fixture_coverage: node classification across all parsed diarios

items.semantic_responsibility: name the operation-owned content link classes
items.bde_specific_evidence: none — emitted taxonomy, source-independent
items.why: part of the emitted semantic contract (audit depends on the names)

items.semantic_responsibility: enumerate candidate spans for head-level locators
items.bde_specific_evidence: 'Disposición <tipo> <ordinal>', 'ANEJO <n>', 'Fichero: <name>', 'madrid,' signature boundary
items.why: heading patterns and boundary words are profile vocabulary; enumerate-all-hits + span-to-next-heading + duplicate-surfacing are core candidate policy (B1/B2)

items.bde_specific_evidence: BOE marker typography incl. the tolerant forms added by F2
items.why: marker patterns and the kind->pattern map are profile grammar; the level-aware boundary policy and enumerate-then-adjudicate discipline are core — this is the canonical PROFILE_INPUT_CORE_POLICY seam
items.fixture_coverage: test_cov2_markers; F2 conversion set (31 unique / 2 ambiguous)

items.item: locator-key syntax: _locator_parts, 'kind:value' dotted components, bare-segment continuation rule
items.semantic_responsibility: parse the canonical locator_key into components
items.bde_specific_evidence: the kind vocabulary is BdE; the key format itself is RegDelta's own contract
items.why: the 'kind:value' dotted format is core ledger vocabulary (byte-identical obligation); the kind set, ordinal words and value-continuation alphabet are profile

items.item: candidate enumeration + adjudication: sub_region_candidates, text_region_candidates traversal, decide, abstain, STATUSES
items.semantic_responsibility: B1/B2 semantics: enumerate all, bound iff unique, ambiguity abstains
items.bde_specific_evidence: none — operates over a profile-supplied document model and pattern set
items.why: the fail-closed enumeration contract; entirely source-independent once patterns/spans are injected

items.bde_specific_evidence: state-code families + 'ANEJO' marker + anexo node class

items.bde_specific_evidence: none — pure adjudication
items.why: emitted status taxonomy + adjudication rules; source-independent

items.bde_specific_evidence: Spanish disposición vocabulary and prefix scheme
items.why: vocabulary + code spelling (emitted in clause ids — must stay byte-identical, but spelling is profile-owned)
